notes.title: HeadHunters Steam Playtest — Live Now
notes.content:
Playtest is LIVE — jump in now!
Thanks for helping us break (and improve) HeadHunters — a chaotic platform-brawler where losing your head is just the start. Borrow a body, swing something ridiculous, and send your friends flying.


What’s in this Playtest
Online matchmaking + private lobbies

Local couch play

A slice of stages, characters and weapons

Controller support (recommended)


How to Join[olist]
Open the HeadHunters Steam page.

Click Request Access under “Playtest.”

Download & play. No keys, no forms.
[/olist]

Feedback we need
Balance (weapons, knockback, abilities)

Netcode stability & performance

UI/UX pain points
Post in Steam Discussions → Playtest Feedback or use the in-game feedback prompt if you see it.


Timing
Live now through the weekend. We may extend the Playtest based on demand—watch this post for updates.
